dict.string: Talys needs accessibility access to manage and tile your windows.
Talys shows a live microphone level in the sound panel while it's open. Audio is never recorded or stored.
macOS only reveals the Wi-Fi network name to apps with Location access. Talys uses it to show your network in the bar.
